title: WebAI 2026 Badge
description: Patched firmware for the WebAI 2026 conference's ePaper badge (an Espruino ESP32-C3 board). The badge front carries a LinkedIn QR code on a clean layout, and the agenda pages are replaced with GitHub profile pages: a contribution heatmap, the language mix, a GitHub QR code and 20 repositories, with the LEDs as a redraw progress bar.
